recipeSteps.text: Spread the peanut butter on the bread.
Spread the jelly on the other slice.
Pour the milk into a pot.
Add the oats to the pot.
Stir until the oatmeal is thick.

spread.label: spread
spread.definition: To put something over a surface in a thin layer.

pour.label: pour
pour.definition: To make a liquid flow from a container.

add.label: add
add.definition: To put something together with something else.

stir.label: stir
stir.definition: To mix something by moving a spoon around.

chop.label: chop
chop.definition: To cut something into pieces with a knife.

mix.label: mix
mix.definition: To combine two or more things together.
